Name: Wizard Sprites for Eskbl's Portraits
Author: VampireCowboi
Description:
I love Eskbl's Wizard portrait but was super bummed there wasn't a matching sprite... so I made one!

Eskbl's Wizard Portrait: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7529]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7529[/url]
Matches the 'slightly cuter aesthetic' style.
Has the necessary sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]Romancable Rasmodius Revamped Redux (RRRR)[/url].
Just one outfit & beach sprites-- no seasonal outfits.

I haven't fully tested this so let me know if anything looks off.

[b][u]REQUIREMENTS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[/list]
[b][u]COMPATIBILITY[/u]
[/b][list]
[*]If you are using Romancable Rasmodius Redux Revamp (RRRR) set "Sprites" to "Use Custom" and Beach Sprites to TRUE.
[*]If you are using[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450] Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿, set "SlightlyCuterWizard" to FALSE.
[*]If you are using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]﻿, you will need to delete the entire "Magnus" folder located in Mods/[CP] Seasonal Cuter Characters SVE/assets/Characters. You shouldn't have to delete the "Wizard" folder.
[/list]
[b][u]CHANGELOG
[/u][/b]04/25/24   1.1.1:
[list]
[*]Changed how my sprite is loaded by Content Patcher; should now overwrite the Wizard/Magnus sprite last in most cases. 
[*] ﻿(ex. if you're playing with ONLY SVE, no RRRR or other character replacers, will now replace the sprite appropriately)
[*]Replace Arcane Hat will now work for animals too!

[/list]1.1.0:
[list]
[*]Added configs for the following:
[/list] ﻿ ﻿○ Beach Scars: (Default is set to True) Show scars on the Wizard's beach sprite, matching his beach portrait.
         ﻿○ Replace Arcane Hat: (Default is set to true) Makes the Arcane Hat look like the hat he wears in this mod.[list]
[*]Added an optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ mod for the Arcane Hat. You can change it's color in the Fashion Sense hand mirror menu!       

[/list]
[b][u]INSTALLATION[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Install by extracting the zip file and placing in your Stardew/Mods Folder
[*]Review the compatibility section and make any necessary changes.
[*]Run the game once and change any config options if needed. 
[/list] ﻿ ○ ﻿I recommend using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] so you can edit configs in game.
[list]
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
- Fixed load order priority; will now load last in almost all cases (basically more likely to replace your sprite, regardless of what other mods you have that might alter it.)
- Arcane Hat is now replaced for animals too
